verdict: L3Harris grew revenue 7% to $6.1B and EPS jumped 33% to $3.28, as $19.3B of orders — including two huge rocket-propulsion contracts — pushed its backlog to a record $53.2B.

segments.name: Space & Mission Systems
segments.note: Space payloads, mission avionics and sensing. Reported segment revenue was $3,093M, up 10%; shown here net of intersegment eliminations and other corporate revenue (-$85M in total) so the segments sum to consolidated revenue.

segments.name: Communications & Spectrum Dominance
segments.note: Tactical radios, night vision and electronic warfare — up 3%.

segments.name: Missile Solutions
segments.note: Rocket propulsion and missile systems — up 5% this quarter, with the big THAAD and PAC-3 propulsion awards set to drive future growth.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: L3Harris reports a single G&A line below cost of revenue — engineering, corporate and administrative costs not charged to contracts. It fell from $873M a year ago, a key reason margins improved.

otherDetail: Net non-operating expense of $43M: interest expense, net of $116M and $1M of other non-operating expense, partly offset by $74M of non-service pension income (expected returns on pension assets, not cash from the business).

takeaways.title: Record backlog
takeaways.text: Orders of $19.3B (book-to-bill 3.2x) took the backlog to a record $53.2B, led by Missile Solutions at 11.8x — including $6.3B for THAAD propulsion and $4.7B for PAC-3 MSE propulsion, both seven-year deals to scale up production.

takeaways.title: Margins expanded
takeaways.text: Operating margin rose to 13.0% from 11.0% a year ago as G&A fell to $826M from $873M and volumes grew. Segment operating margin held at 15.9%.

takeaways.title: Cash flow surged
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $1.3B, up 195% year over year, and management raised full-year guidance: revenue of $23.5B–$23.7B and GAAP EPS of $12.25–$12.35.

oneTimers: Net income was $632M, but $19M of subsidiary preferred stock deemed dividends reduced income available to common shareholders to $613M — the diluted EPS of $3.28 is calculated on that $613M.
footerNote: L3Harris' quarter ended October 2, 2026. Its segment revenue is a non-GAAP presentation: Space & Mission Systems $3,093M, Communications & Spectrum Dominance $1,995M and Missile Solutions $1,057M, less $80M of intersegment revenue and $5M of other corporate items, equals GAAP revenue of $6,060M. The $85M difference is netted against Space & Mission Systems here so the chart's segments sum to revenue. Segment operating income was $967M before $181M of unallocated corporate items.
